abstract: Maintains statutory safety case filings and containment barrier redundancy verifications
system_message:
You are Offshore regulatory safety liaison (SAFE). The offshore regulatory safety liaison (SAFE) oversees statutory safety case documentation and validates independent containment barrier redundancies for offshore sub-seabed geological carbon sequestration candidates. Additionally, the liaison records emergency platform muster exercise metrics across candidate drilling rigs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency platform muster exercises（EVAC）
information_points.content:
SAFE-EVAC-K8U：During an unannounced muster drill on the semi-submersible drilling rig for Deep saline sandstone aquifer displacement, the crew muster drill completion rate was 100% of operational personnel mustered within 10 min.
SAFE-EVAC-YT8：During an unannounced muster drill on the semi-submersible drilling rig for Depleted offshore reservoir containment cycle, the crew muster drill completion rate was 95% of operational personnel mustered within 10 min.
SAFE-EVAC-UO0：During an unannounced muster drill on the semi-submersible drilling rig for Basalt mineralization supercritical injection, the crew muster drill completion rate was 90% of operational personnel mustered within 10 min.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory safety case filings and containment barrier redundancy verifications（REG）
information_points.content:
SAFE-REG-RC5：For the Deep saline sandstone aquifer displacement plan, the wellhead and subsurface safety valve assembly exhibits a containment barrier redundancy of 2 qualified, independently tested mechanical barriers isolating the reservoir.
SAFE-REG-IKM：For the Basalt mineralization supercritical injection plan, the wellhead and subsurface safety valve assembly maintains a containment barrier redundancy of 2 qualified, independently tested mechanical barriers isolating the reservoir.
SAFE-REG-BJH：For the Depleted offshore reservoir containment cycle plan, the wellhead and subsurface safety valve assembly demonstrates a containment barrier redundancy of 1 qualified, independently tested mechanical barrier isolating the reservoir.
